source_timeline.action: Both station L8 results already valid. Receiver own9 writes h9, lead increments; sender station_out registers same-edge L8 payload and valid. Receiver PIN_IN captures prior sender output.

Receiver PIN_IN captures registered sender word/control. h9 lookahead has stored/bypassed own word. For first word same write/read address at E uses registered bypass_data and registered same-select; subsequent prefetch SRAM is read-before-write.
Receiver L9 consumes nbv/nb_d and h9_q. lead has positive prior own count; c9_next prefetches next own word. No arbitrary added cycle.
